<action type="say">
I can set that up.

To get accurate quotes and availability, I need a few details:

1) Address/area: What’s the full address (or at least city + ZIP) where the work will be done?
2) Timing: 
   - Is this routine, same-day, or an emergency?
   - Any preferred date and time window (morning/afternoon/evening or specific hours)?
3) Faucet & sink details:
   - Is this a straight swap (old faucet out, new faucet in) with all existing plumbing in place?
   - Do you already have the new faucet? If yes, what type (single-handle, pull-down sprayer, touchless, etc.)?
   - Any issues under the sink now (shutoff valves stuck, corrosion, leaks, disposal or dishwasher connections)?
4) Access/parking: Any building restrictions (elevator, parking rules, need for insurance certificate, etc.)?
5) Quotes: Do you want multiple quotes (e.g., 3–5 plumbers) or just the best-rated few?

Reply with those details and I’ll pull in local plumbers and start lining up quotes.</action>
